vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: guardrail-smart-accounts
Version: 1.1.0

The skill provides a well-documented interface for managing ERC-4337 smart accounts with on-chain guardrails via the AgentGuardrail service (agentguardrail.xyz). It includes robust security instructions for the AI agent, explicitly forbidding the request or storage of private keys and warning against accessing unrelated environment variables. The skill utilizes the standard ERC-4337 EntryPoint contract (0x5FF137D4b0FDCD49DcA30c7CF57E578a026d2789) and provides transparent information regarding its fee structure and contract addresses, with no evidence of malicious intent or prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and instructions are internally consistent with its stated purpose (deploying and enforcing ERC‑4337 smart accounts) and do not request unrelated secrets or install arbitrary code.

dimensions.detail: The skill is about on‑chain smart accounts and requests exactly the things needed for that: chain ID, JSON‑RPC URL (primaryEnv), and a signing mode. These environment variables are appropriate for preparing and submitting transactions and for integrating with an external signer; nothing requested appears unrelated to the described functionality.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md focuses on preparing UserOperations, using an external signer or wallet connector, and policy management via the AgentGuardrail API. It explicitly forbids asking for or persisting private keys and says to operate in read‑only mode if signing is not configured. No instructions request unrelated filesystem access, cloud credentials, or data exfiltration.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction‑only skill with no install spec and no code files, so it does not write or execute third‑party artifacts on disk — the lowest installer risk profile.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Required env vars are limited and proportionate: GUARDRAIL_CHAIN_ID, GUARDRAIL_RPC_URL, and GUARDRAIL_SIGNING_MODE. Optional secrets (signer endpoint/auth token, dashboard API key) are justified by the supported signing modes and management API. The skill does not ask for private keys, cloud creds, or unrelated tokens.

dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent with its purpose, but you should still be cautious: 1) Never paste private keys or seed phrases into chat — follow the external_signer or wallet_connector modes. 2) Treat GUARDRAIL_RPC_URL as sensitive (it can include provider API keys); use a scoped RPC key where possible. 3) Review and audit the deployed smart contract addresses and permission policies before funding accounts—on‑chain transactions are irreversible. 4) If using an external signer, verify the signer enforces the same policy scope and rate limits you expect (MPC/HSM/provider trust). 5) Test thoroughly on a testnet or with minimal funds before full use, and rotate/limit any session keys or API keys used by the skill.
